svg.title: Mexico study map
svg.desc: Representative places for orientation. These dots are not legal wine-area boundaries. Named towns locate the surrounding study area; the country window may omit distant territory. 1: Valle de Guadalupe; 2: Parras, Coahuila; 3: Querétaro near Ezequiel Montes; 4: Guanajuato near San Miguel; 5: Aguascalientes; 6: Mexico City; 7: Monterrey; 8: Guadalajara; 9: Puebla; 10: Tampico; 11: Chihuahua; 12: Mazatlán

g.title: 3 · Querétaro near Ezequiel Montes: representative location
4 · Guanajuato near San Miguel: representative location

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine
